== Summary ==
Change crop (before) for [[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel]]: the region (428, 700, 620, 748) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel (Playtest)]] (Playtest): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/jynersoheroicrebel.gif Holotable commit 73ae2bd] (2023-12-20). The matching after crop is [[:File:V23-L-jynersoheroicrebel-2024-07-20-change-crop-after.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel (Playtest)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/jynersoheroicrebel.gif commit 73ae2bd]) and [[Jyn Erso, Heroic Rebel]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/jynersoheroicrebel.gif commit 335d47f]).
